objective: Resolve newly reported dependency-audit failures by updating the vulnerable filelock and setuptools pins while preserving reproducible CI environments.

baseline.status: The default-branch dependency audit pinned filelock 4.0.3 and setuptools 84.0.0. CI run 40123404290 reported 4 known vulnerabilities: three affecting filelock 4.0.3 (fix version 4.2.1) and one affecting setuptools 84.0.0 (fix version 84.1.0).

security.before: Dependency Audit fails with four known vulnerabilities in two packages
security.after: Update filelock to 4.2.1 and setuptools to 84.1.0; require fresh pip-audit results before acceptance

reproducibility.after: All CI workflow pins and requirements.lock use the same reviewed versions

evidence: Audit log from run 40123404290 lists the vulnerable packages and fix versions.
Updated requirements.lock and all 13 setuptools workflow pins across CI, scientific validation, release, and product-scope audit workflows.
validation.blocker: New branch CI and dependency audit must pass; dependency resolution and tests must confirm the new pins are compatible.

root_causes: New advisories now affect pinned filelock 4.0.3 and setuptools 84.0.0, so the previously green dependency audit fails.

findings: Pinned build tools and lockfile dependencies must be refreshed when new advisories identify fixed versions.
A green CI result from an earlier date does not prove the same dependency pins remain vulnerability-free.

open_blockers: Run CI and inspect the Dependency Audit job on this branch.
Check all workflow files for stale vulnerable pins and verify no lock inconsistencies.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not weaken or skip the dependency audit to obtain green CI.
Keep scientific baseline v0.2.0 and released artifacts unchanged.
